artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and let $\pi : T^*M 	o M$ denote the cotangent bundle projection, with canonical coordinates $(x,p)$. Let $H : T^*M 	o \mathbb{R}$ be a Tonelli Hamiltonian (i.e. $H$ is $C^2$, fiberwise strictly convex, and superlinear in $p$), and let $L : TM 	o \mathbb{R}$ be its associated Lagrangian, defined by the Legendre transform
$$L(x,\dot x) = p\cdot \dot x - H(x,p), \qquad \dot x = \partial_p H(x,p).$$
Let $f : T^*M 	o \mathbb{R}$ be a smooth function (a friction/forcing coefficient), and let $\eta$ be a closed $1$-form on $T^*M$. Decompose $\eta =  ar\eta_x \cdot dx +  ar\eta_p \cdot dp$ in canonical coordinates, and assume $ ar\eta_p = 0$, so that $\eta = \pi^* ar\eta$ is the pullback of a closed $1$-form $ ar\eta =  ar\eta_x \cdot dx$ on $M$. Consider the forced Hamiltonian system
$$\dot x = \partial_p H(x,p), \qquad \dot p = -\partial_x H(x,p) + f\,p - L(x,\dot x)\, ar\eta_x.$$
The term $f\,p$ admits the standard physical interpretation of a momentum-dependent dissipation or repulsion. 

Problem: Determine whether the additional forcing term $-L(x,\dot x)\, ar\eta_x$ admits a physical interpretation, and if so identify it.
